option_relations.rationale: Right ventricular infarction is a component of the leaf diagnosis, but the option is incomplete as a diagnosis.

The option describes mirror-image dextrocardia with acute inferior wall and right ventricular myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion, which is clinically equivalent to the leaf's 'Acute inferior ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion in a patient with dextrocardia and situs inversus'.
Acute inferior-lateral ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) is a component of the leaf diagnosis, but the option is incomplete as a diagnosis.
Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion is a component of the leaf diagnosis, but the option is incomplete as a diagnosis.
